newsitem.title: USA: Powell says sees improved earnings in 97.
newsitem.headline: Powell says sees improved earnings in 97.

text.p: Powell Industries Inc said Thursday it expects continued improvement in revenues and earnings for the rest of 1997, and it is optimistic that its 1998 performance will show continued improvement over 1997.
The company said it has benefitted from increased spending by its oil and gas industry customers, and has entered new markets by expanding its product lines.
The company reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.30 compared to earnings per share of $0.25 for the same period a year ago.
Powell Industries makes electrical energy systems and equipment.
